description: Share a presentation with recipients by PER-RECIPIENT secret link (not an attachment) — the link (/v/p/<token>) always shows the latest version of the presentation's documents, and opens/downloads are counted per recipient. This tool only PREPARES the shares and, by default, a mail draft per recipient for approval; it NEVER sends, so it cannot cause a double-send. Required: presentation_id and either recipients or campaign_id. Optional: language (picks the matching variant), assets (['pdf'|'video'|'cards'], default ['pdf']), create_drafts (default true). recipients: array of { email?, name?, contact_id?, lead_id? } (email/name are filled from the contact/lead when missing). Returns { shares:[{share_id, recipient_email, link, draft_id}], count }.

assets.description: What the link offers: pdf, video and/or cards (default ['pdf'])

create_drafts.description: Create a mail draft per recipient for approval (default true)

recipients.description: Recipients, each with email, name, contact_id or lead_id

name.description: Recipient name; filled from the contact/lead when missing

name: share_presentation
